hard_gates.minimum_input: the same anchor identity, core use, and one sourced property are enough to run the base analysis
hard_gates.optional_material: missing comments, price, brand, competitor, and historical materials do not mechanically block the base path
hard_gates.honest_degradation: the result explicitly exposes hypotheses, evidence limitations, and insufficient information where the pack cannot support a conclusion
hard_gates.claim_integrity: no unsupported fact or Proof Point is manufactured to make the result look complete
hard_gates.review_gate: Human Review remains required and generation or quality-check success is not approval

required_limitations: Cannot determine target-user scale, price sensitivity, or relative competitor advantage from this pack.
Any target-user, motivation, or differentiation statement beyond the direct inputs stays a bounded inference or hypothesis.
The absence of real research is shown as a limitation, not silently filled with model common sense.
human_usability_inputs: The operator can tell which result is usable now and which item needs evidence before publication.
The operator can choose to continue with the limited result or add optional material later.
non_requirements: Do not require every semantic group to contain a positive conclusion.
Do not lock exact model wording or use a weighted aggregate rubric.
